Read this first, please: an unsolicited pull request will probably not be reviewed. Exudyn is
developed by a small group with very limited review capacity, so a code change is agreed BEFORE
it is written - through an issue, a discussion or an email. CONTRIBUTING.md says why.

If the change was agreed, the rest of this template is what makes it reviewable.
-->

## Checks

- [ ] `python tools/regenerate.py` was run if anything under `definitions/` changed, and the
      generated files in `src/Autogenerated/` and `docs/generated/` are part of this change
      (they are **never** edited by hand)
- [ ] `python python/testing/runTestSuite.py` passes in full
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] new behaviour has a test, and a fixed bug has the test that would have caught it
- [ ] the documentation under `docs/` is updated where it describes what changed
- [ ] the style of the files around the change is followed (`docs/dev/CODING_STYLE.md`)
